issues.issue: 98% of this nonmajor line is the Ambulance fund, so under the mixed-line rule the dominant category is Ambulance Fees (detail_category ambulance/rescue fees). The printed label is generic, so charges for services is defensible.
The schedule doesn't break this down. Highway allocation is an assumption: the Road Fund's intergovernmental receipts may include federal or other state road money.
